disclosure_correction: The initial status text was corrected to record that the required committed Rank 5 report had already exposed aggregate outcomes. No policy, threshold, split, metric, or gate changed in that correction.
status: frozen_before_raw-capture, per-bin, or alternate-policy inspection; aggregate Rank 5 outcomes were already disclosed by the required committed report
hypothesis: A payload-independent GMI policy derived from randomized known probes will improve held-out p10 setup-inclusive net goodput over the uniform 16-QAM incumbent by at least 5% while preserving at least 98% ordered block recovery.

excluded.reason: preflight failure; no received data probe

corpus.holdout_rule: No threshold, margin, mask, MCS, decoder, or policy change may be made after raw R2 PCM, per-bin data EVM, expected bytes, CRC details, or a policy score is inspected. The required committed Rank 5 report had already disclosed aggregate R2 block counts before this freeze, so R2 is not a blind holdout.
corpus.generalization_limit: R2 is an order-balanced repeat of the reverse physical cell, not a held-out device or geometry, and its aggregate result is outcome-exposed. It can support only a diagnostic replay, not held-out calibration or a whole-device/cell generalization claim.

required: known independently randomized payload for every scored burst
physically transmitted waveform for every candidate allocation and MCS in every scored cell, or a proven sufficient statistic preserving the exact coded observations
candidate selection frozen from causally prior sounder, passive-noise, route, and pilot observations
strict ordered recovered application bytes and CRC for each physically transmitted candidate
insufficient_examples: masking bins from a recording of a different codeword and treating the result as a lower-rate transmission
using expected payload bytes, data-bin EVM, block validity, or CRC to select that frame
predicting goodput from stationary PSD without a physically observed candidate outcome
treating repeated-pilot capacity arithmetic as measured application goodput
counterfactual_identifiability.formal_stop: If the retained corpus does not meet every requirement, do not report a counterfactual goodput delta and do not authorize OTA from an invented replay gain. Implement the payload-independent estimator and produce an acquisition manifest instead.

fixed_phy.eligible_bins: the immutable eligible-bin list in the Rank 5 waveform manifest; nominal count 935
fixed_phy.fec: existing constraint-length-7 rate-1/2 convolutional code with the existing interleaver and CRC
fixed_phy.normalization: Each physically transmitted policy candidate uses the same digital sample-peak ceiling, OS volume, active band, NFFT, CP, training, and burst duration. Report received RMS only as a diagnostic.

policies.rule: Assign 4 bits to every eligible bin. Do not inspect channel or payload outcomes.
Using only the causally prior active known-probe channel magnitude and passive-noise PSD, assign 0 bits below 6 dB SNR, 2 bits from 6 dB inclusive to 13 dB exclusive, and 4 bits at or above 13 dB.

Using only causally prior known sounder/pilot observations and the frozen scalar residual model, assign the highest modulation whose estimated BICM-GMI is at least 1.20 bits/symbol for QPSK or 2.40 bits/symbol for 16-QAM; otherwise turn the bin off.

For independently verified simultaneous microphone inputs, estimate payload-independent complex H and regularized passive-noise covariance, compute the maximum-SINR combiner, then apply P2 thresholds. Fall back exactly to P2 for one usable input or an invalid covariance estimate.

fitting.only_permitted_training_fit: A single scalar GMI calibration offset may be selected from {-0.50, -0.25, 0.00} bits/symbol using complete training runs only. Use the most conservative tied value. Development may reject the estimator but may not select a new value.
fitting.holdout: No fit or redesign on R2, but R2 is not blind because its aggregate result was disclosed. Future OTA qualification must hold out at least one complete, outcome-blind device/geometry cell.

allocation_signalling.descriptor: two bits per eligible bin plus 128 metadata/CRC bits
allocation_signalling.bearer_assumption: uniform QPSK with the same rate-1/2 convolutional code across 935 bins
allocation_signalling.profile_id_cost: 32 logical bits reserved from application payload in every data frame
allocation_signalling.accounting: Both descriptor airtime and per-frame profile-ID payload displacement are included in candidate net goodput. P0 has no descriptor activation cost in the incumbent comparison.

objectives.primary: p10 across whole held-out run/cell net goodput in delivered ordered application bits divided by wall-clock seconds including training, allocation signalling, profile-ID displacement, padding, and failed blocks
objectives.recovery: at least 98.0% strict ordered block recovery and no hash-invalid completed transfer
secondary: active-bin fraction and selected bit distribution
objectives.oracle: best physically transmitted policy candidate in the same whole cell that meets the recovery objective; oracle is used only for retrospective regret, never selection

gates.offline_replay_promotion_to_ota_screen: At least 2.0% p10 net-goodput gain over P0 after signalling, predictor median held-out error <=15%, profile within 10% of measured oracle in >=80% of held-out cells, held-out Spearman >=0.5, and zero catastrophic optimistic selections.
gates.final_promotion: At least 5.0% p10 net-goodput gain, >=98.0% recovery, no hash failure, and wins at least 7 of 8 order-balanced confirmatory pairs after signalling.
gates.catastrophic_selection: selected candidate recovers <90.0%, or selects below 98.0% when another physically measured candidate meets 98.0%
stop: retained corpus is not counterfactually identifiable
any same-frame payload/expected-byte/CRC leakage is found
signalling or lower-tail loss erases the gain

anti_leakage: Policy inputs are limited to route metadata, passive PCM, and known sounder/pilot samples ending before candidate payload transmission.
Payload subcarriers, expected payload bytes, decoded bytes, block masks, CRC, and same-frame data EVM are outcome-only fields.
Selection and its SHA-256 record must be written before candidate payload outcome decoding.
Thresholds and the optional scalar offset are selected on whole training runs; no frame split is permitted.
All candidates in one cell use independent payload seeds, while order is balanced and seed assignment is committed before acquisition.
The policy implementation has a feature allowlist and rejects unrecognized fields rather than silently consuming them.
ota_permission: forbidden by this preregistration until the offline corpus passes counterfactual-identifiability and the full offline gate; if it cannot, a new acquisition requires a separately reviewed executable manifest
